global: This miso ramen features a rich, golden broth, topped with tender chashu pork slices, crisp nori, and sliced green onions. The white bowl rests on a dark wooden table, softly lit to highlight the steamy, inviting meal.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and smooth surface surrounding the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly curved rim, and faint vertical script markings.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth appears creamy, light brown, with visible noodles, green onions, and toppings floating on its smooth, slightly textured surface.
regions.spoon: A black, glossy spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly flared bowl shape.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed: dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible grainy surface and slightly curled edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show tender, marbled texture with translucent fat, curved edges, and faint grill marks on their surface.
